movie_title: Do you get jealous easily? ⏲️ 6 Minute English
introduction: Do you get jealous if one of your friends gives more attention to someone else? Do you keep checking

vocabulary.definition: a feeling of wanting to have what someone else has
vocabulary.example: She couldn't help but feel envy when she saw her colleague's promotion.

vocabulary.definition: a romantic partner with whom one has a long-term relationship
vocabulary.example: She introduced her significant other to her family at the wedding.

vocabulary.definition: behaving as if one is sexually attracted to someone in a playful manner
vocabulary.example: He was caught flirting with a colleague at the office party.

vocabulary.definition: a type of therapy that helps individuals change negative thought patterns and behaviors
vocabulary.example: She decided to try CBT to address her anxiety issues.

vocabulary.definition: keeping track of or observing something or someone closely
vocabulary.example: She was constantly monitoring her partner's social media activity out of jealousy.

vocabulary.definition: the feeling of resentment or unhappiness because someone has what you desire or possess
vocabulary.example: His jealousy towards his friend's success affected their relationship.
